name: Nakano Hitomi
source:
A delinquent girl at the school where Sachi transferred to [spoiler]after the accident involving her parents occurred. She took advantage of Sachi’s absolute obedience, treated her like a slave and made her do many things. One day, she ordered Sachi to “make the test disappear” which led to a large disaster when Sachi burnt down the whole classrooms in order to “make the test disappear”.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://vnsharing.net/forum/showthread.php?t=302644/]Shiori-chan's review[/url].]
